characterField.title: Character field
characterField.summary: An extra field on the character sheets of a world
characterField.description: A field a game master adds to the character sheets of one world, or of every world when no world is set. The values live on the character.

label.title: Label
label.description: The name of the field on the character sheet

key.title: Key
key.description: The key the value is stored under: lower case letters, digits and hyphens

fieldType.title: Field type
fieldType.description: What kind of value the field holds

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: The values a choice field offers

visibility.title: Visible to
visibility.description: Who reads and fills in the field: game masters only, or also the player who owns the character

order.title: Order
order.description: The position of the field on the sheet

help.title: Help text
help.description: A hint shown under the field

setting.title: World
setting.description: The world whose characters get this field; empty for every world

customFields.title: Extra fields
customFields.description: The values of the extra fields the player may read and fill in, by key

customFieldsPrivate.title: Extra fields for game masters
customFieldsPrivate.description: The values of the extra fields only game masters read and fill in, by key
